answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure each identity maps to a unique human. By forcing agents to mirror biological complexity, the system prevents an ivory tower architecture where one actor could echo thousands of sub-identities. An attacker faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring rare, verifiable biometric credentials for each fake node, effectively tethering digital influence to a non-replicable physical scarcity that makes mass identity fabrication economically irrational.
